findings.highlight: it feels like something dark and sinister is swirling at my feet.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面の中では、何か黒々としたものが渦巻いているような、矛盾した熱を感じる。
findings.governingReading: Beneath the frozen air and lifeless-looking buildings he feels heat deep in the ground, associated with a dark swirl.
findings.explanation: Contradictory underground heat becomes a dark swirl at his feet.

findings.highlight: All the kids in that hospital were orphans.
findings.evidenceJa: あの病室にいた子供たちはみんな孤児で
findings.governingReading: 病室 restricts the cohort to the shared sickroom after the fire, not all pediatric patients throughout the institution.
findings.explanation: All children in the one hospital room becomes all children in the hospital.

findings.highlight: cannot attempt two Holy Grail Wars simultaneously
findings.evidenceJa: “聖杯を手に入れる機会”を同時に行えるという訳でもない
findings.governingReading: The source excludes simultaneous opportunities and then explicitly says this Grail War is not her only sort of chance: Grail-related trials exist throughout eras, all of which she can work through.
findings.explanation: Grail-acquisition trials are narrowed to Holy Grail Wars.

findings.highlight: because she's under the belief that she will obtain the Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 『結果として聖杯を手に入れる』からこそ
findings.governingReading: 結果として fixes the outcome that permits the incomplete-contract summons; her subjective confidence is not the stated cause.
findings.explanation: Being summoned because Grail acquisition is the eventual outcome becomes being summoned because she believes it.

findings.highlight: there's no way she can avoid becoming a Servant.
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントでなくす手段はない。
findings.governingReading: なくす concerns making the currently present Servant no longer one;54 contrasts that with enabling human-like life while the body stays a Servant.
findings.explanation: Removing her present Servant status becomes preventing future entry into that status.

findings.highlight: Saber said that the Holy Grail disappeared the moment it was destroyed last time.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは聖杯が壊れた時点で消えたと言っていた。
findings.governingReading: Saber reported her own disappearance at the Grail’s destruction, supporting Shirou’s maintenance question.
findings.explanation: Saber disappearing when the Grail was destroyed becomes the Grail disappearing.

findings.highlight: someone else will prepare another Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: なくなれば、用意した者が新しい聖杯を用意する
findings.governingReading: 用意した者 refers to the party that furnished the vessel, repeated by Shirou and identified as the Einzbern role later.
findings.explanation: The responsible original preparer supplying a replacement becomes someone else supplying it.

findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる神話の根底にある
findings.governingReading: あらゆる makes his assertion universal, whatever the reliability of his in-world mythological account.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s all-myth claim becomes most mythology.

findings.highlight: the omnipotent pot that was nothing more than an artificial Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 人工物に過ぎない聖杯に“万能の釜”を降霊させ
findings.governingReading: 聖杯に identifies the manmade receptacle into which the cauldron is invoked to open the path.
findings.explanation: The supernatural cauldron being invoked into the artificial Grail becomes the cauldron itself being that artificial Grail.

findings.highlight: were able to use the Rheingold.
findings.evidenceJa: ラインの黄金とやらの伝承に長けていて
findings.governingReading: 伝承に長け names adeptness in the tradition/lore; the subsequent specific practical skill is manufacturing a Grail replica.
findings.explanation: Expertise in a Rheingold tradition becomes actual ability to use the Rheingold.

findings.highlight: the two families betrayed each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 二つの家だけでは容易に裏切りが起きてしまう。
findings.governingReading: The source explains structural vulnerability as a possible reason for adding a third counterbalancing house before the later failed cooperative ritual.
findings.explanation: The risk of betrayal with only two houses becomes an actual mutual betrayal.

findings.highlight: He watches me from the door with a condescending twist to his lips.
findings.evidenceJa: 地上にいる俺を見下ろしていた。
findings.governingReading: From the doorway he looks down at Shirou standing below on the ground; 地上 disambiguates the downward geometry.
findings.explanation: A spatially downward gaze becomes an invented condescending lip expression.
